description_en: Duplicates a production studio and creates a new production studio instance
description_zh: 复制导播台，复制指定导播台并返回新导播台实例
kebab_example: aliyun live copy-caster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-name caster001 --src-caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --client-token 53200b81-b761-4c10-842a-a0726d970000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyCaster

parameters.help_en: The name of the new production studio
parameters.name: caster_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio to copy.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value that is returned.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio to view the production studio name.

The name of a production studio on the Cloud Production Studio page is its production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
原导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台路径查看导播台名称。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: src_caster_id

parameters.help_en:
A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value for this parameter for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
